main_text.p: Ὤχετο Καλβῖνος, σὺν ἀπῴχετο ψυχὴ λυγρά,[?]
Ὤχετο χεῖνος ἀνὴρ, ὤχοντο δὲ χαὶ λύχνοι αὐγοί,[?]
Ἀλλ' οὐχ οἰχομένοις ἀπεαπὸς μία ἐπλετο Τύτοις.[?]
Εἰς γὰρ Ὄλυμπον ὁ μὲν, οἱ δ' ἀϊδὸς δὲ ἕβαι.[?]
main_text.head: IN EVNDEM TH. BEZA.

p.i: Te viuo, Caluine, fuit mihi viuere dulce:
Hei cur non licuit te moriente mori.
Et tamen est, fateor, grata hoc mihi nomine vita,
Quod, tibi quas fundam, sufficiat lacrymas.
Viue igitur, Beza, in luctus, tibi vt usque peren-Caluini in tumulū vita ministret aquas. (nes Iunctura absenti donec te rursus amico Mors, pariter vitam finiat & lacrymas.

main_text.head: A. CEVALLERII IN EVNDEM.

p.i: Chara quibus fuerit Caluini vita, laborum Gratior eiusdem vita perennis erit.
Hac siquidem viuit morti tumulóque superstes, Et sacrum Christo pascit, vt ante gregem.

page.notes: The Greek lines are hard to read on the scan; the letters are copied as far as they can be seen and are marked [?]. The "(nes" at the line end is a fragment, kept as printed. The running head at the top is too faint to read and is left out.
